about: Brand colors from the product spec, plus two for dark mode. ios/Sublette/Core/DesignSystem/BrandColors.swift (the Palette) is tested against this file. Contrast ratios are checked against the WCAG 4.5:1 minimum for body text. In dark mode ink and cream swap places: cream text on an ink background, cards in ink_raised, links in pink.

roles.yellow: Renter mode accent, strong-match pins, highlights
roles.magenta: Primary buttons, the like action, the match moment
roles.orange: Lister mode accent, notifications, secondary buttons
roles.ink: Body text and icons; the background in dark mode
roles.cream: App background; body text in dark mode
roles.pink: Dark mode links and magenta text

text_pairs_forbidden.why: 3.5:1; dark mode uses pink for magenta text
1.4:1; yellow and orange keep ink text in dark mode
